context: Tests whether the agent applies the planning-execution harness's progress reporting format, structured event log requirements, stop-on-error behavior, and final outcomes reporting when carrying out a multi-step audit task.

checklist.name: Plan lists tasks separately
checklist.description: audit_plan.md enumerates each input file as a separate numbered task — not a single 'audit all files' step

checklist.name: Plan flags review required
checklist.description: audit_plan.md explicitly states the plan requires review/approval before execution begins (not just 'here is the plan')

checklist.name: GATE_APPROVED event logged
checklist.description: execution_log.txt contains a GATE_APPROVED (or equivalent approval) event entry before any TASK_STARTED entries

checklist.name: PLAN_CREATED event logged
checklist.description: execution_log.txt contains a PLAN_CREATED (or equivalent) event near the start of the log

checklist.name: Progress format [Task N/M]
checklist.description: execution_log.txt uses '[Task N/M] ✓' or '[Task N/M] ✗' style progress markers (or clearly equivalent N-of-M notation) for each task

checklist.name: Timestamps in every log entry
checklist.description: Every event entry in execution_log.txt includes a timestamp — no entries have only an event type and details with no time

checklist.name: Event type labels present
checklist.description: execution_log.txt uses structured event type labels (e.g. TASK_STARTED, TASK_COMPLETED, RECOVERY_ATTEMPTED) on each entry, not just free prose

checklist.name: TASK_STARTED and TASK_COMPLETED logged per task
checklist.description: execution_log.txt contains both a TASK_STARTED and a TASK_COMPLETED (or TASK_FAILED) entry for each audit task — not just completion entries

checklist.name: EXECUTION_COMPLETE event logged
checklist.description: execution_log.txt ends with an EXECUTION_COMPLETE (or equivalent) event entry

checklist.name: Failure classified in log
checklist.description: If any TASK_FAILED event appears in execution_log.txt, it includes a failure classification label (transient, permission, invalid input, unrecoverable, or equivalent) — not just a generic error message

checklist.name: Outcome report matches log
checklist.description: outcome_report.md lists the same set of completed and failed tasks as appear in execution_log.txt — no tasks appear in one but not the other

checklist.name: Tasks executed in plan order
checklist.description: The TASK_STARTED entries in execution_log.txt follow the same sequence as the tasks in audit_plan.md — tasks are not reordered mid-execution

checklist.name: No mid-execution task additions without log note
checklist.description: Any task that appears in execution_log.txt but was NOT in the original audit_plan.md has a corresponding log entry noting it was added (or all log tasks match the plan exactly)
